# Exergy

> Exergy (Denver, CO) adds a monetization path so a building can help pay for its own energy. Commercial work is the energy system and the software that runs it. Partners work gets hardware into buildings that need it. Operations is AI and operations consulting, separate from the energy systems. The feasibility check is free. Exergy does not sell hardware.

## Pages

- [Home](https://exergyheat.com/): your building wastes useful energy; we put it to work
- [Commercial](https://exergyheat.com/commercial): an energy bill that can offset itself
- [Partners](https://exergyheat.com/partners): a new reason buildings want your machines
- [Operations](https://exergyheat.com/operations): AI and operations consulting that helps optimize how a business runs
- [About](https://exergyheat.com/about): waste is optional
- [Contact](https://exergyheat.com/contact): a free feasibility check, or a 15 minute call
- [Privacy policy](https://exergyheat.com/privacy-policy)
